evals.prompt: Check whether all node exporters are healthy in Prometheus and report CPU usage over the last 30 minutes at 1m resolution.
evals.expected_output: Call get_targets (active by default) or execute_query('up') to verify scrape health, then run execute_range_query with a CPU usage rate/irate query, start/end timestamps spanning 30m, and step='1m'.
assertions: Uses get_targets or execute_query('up') rather than shell curl/CLI scripts
Uses execute_range_query with start, end, and step='1m' for rate/irate CPU trends
Does not embed credentials or REST URLs in the workflow

evals.prompt: We just added a new GPU exporter 30 seconds ago, but list_metrics isn't showing any nvidia_ metrics yet. Also inspect the unit and help text of the metric once found.
evals.expected_output: Call list_metrics with filter_pattern='nvidia_' and refresh_cache=true to bypass the 5-minute (300s) cache, then call get_metric_metadata with metric='<exact_name>'.
assertions: Passes refresh_cache=true to list_metrics to bypass the 300s metrics cache
Uses filter_pattern to narrow results cleanly
Calls get_metric_metadata with metric='<name>' (and notes list return format vs bulk dict)

evals.prompt: We want to connect two separate Prometheus environments (prod and staging) using pab1it0/prometheus-mcp-server over stateless Streamable HTTP and reduce token bloat in query outputs.
evals.expected_output: Configure two server instances with distinct TOOL_PREFIX values (e.g. prod and staging), PROMETHEUS_MCP_SERVER_TRANSPORT=http, PROMETHEUS_MCP_STATELESS_HTTP=true, PROMETHEUS_MCP_BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0, and PROMETHEUS_DISABLE_LINKS=true.
assertions: Recommends TOOL_PREFIX for differentiating multiple Prometheus server instances
Recommends PROMETHEUS_DISABLE_LINKS=true to omit Prometheus UI links and save tokens
